text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Wahhh!
This monster sure looks like a toughie...
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃあっ！
ずいぶん頑丈そうな魔物さんね……！

text_block_list.name: Shinobu
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, miss.
Please stand back. It's dangerous here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこの方。
下がってください、
危ないですよ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no! I'm a teacher, you know!
I have to protect my sweet little students!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううん！
　私、先生だもの！
かわいい生徒たちを守らなきゃ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Fine words, bravely spoken.
If you mean to fight, be sure to keep your focus!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なかなか良い心がけじゃ。
戦うというなら、
気を抜くでないぞっ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Miss Io's ready to do her best! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ！
先生、頑張っちゃう♪
